description: Re-derive a Verified Fix Record offline. Recomputes the record hash and re-checks that its verdict follows from its own evidence, so a record that was edited after it was issued fails here. Needs no workspace, no network, and no Dvalin state — call it to confirm that a fix record handed to you is sound before relying on it.

record.description: The fix record JSON, as issued by dvalin_verify_findings or `dvalin verify --record`.

name: dvalin_verify_fix
